description_en: Retrieves all phone numbers of a Cloud Call Center instance
description_zh: 获取呼叫中心实例的所有电话号码
name: ListPhoneNumbers

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance for which to retrieve phone numbers
parameters.help_zh: 待获取电话号码的呼叫中心实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to include only outbound phone numbers
parameters.name: outbound_only

PhoneNumber.description_en: The list of all phone numbers of the Cloud Call Center instance
PhoneNumber.description_zh: 获取到的呼叫中心实例的所有电话号码列表

AllowOutbound.description_en:
Indicates whether outbound calls are allowed. The result depends on:

The provider settings. For example, 400 numbers do not allow outbound calls.
The Cloud Call Center instance settings.

Phone numbers generally allow inbound calls. If inbound calls are not allowed, you can: 1) Configure the provider settings so that callers hear a prompt tone when dialing the number. 2) Unbind the contact flow IVR from the number. However, this approach is not recommended
AllowOutbound.description_zh:
是否允许外呼，结果取决于：

大于的设置，比如400号码不允许外呼
呼叫中心实例的设置

电话号码一般都允许内呼，如果不允许内呼，可以1）由大于做设置，用户拨打该号码时听到提示音 2）该号码不绑定联系流IVR，但是ACC不建议这么做

Assignee.description_en: The assignee of the number, such as a skill group ID

City.description_en: The city of the phone number

ContactFlow.description_en: The contact flow IVR associated with the phone number
ContactFlow.description_zh: 电话号码所连接的联系流IVR

ContactFlowDescription.description_en: The description of the contact flow

ContactFlowId.description_en: The unique ID of the contact flow. This is a unique identifier automatically generated by the system
ContactFlowId.description_zh: 联系流唯一ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

ContactFlowName.description_en: The contact flow name. The name must be unique within an instance
ContactFlowName.description_zh: 联系流名称，在一个实例内名称不能重复

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Cloud Call Center instance to which the contact flow belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 联系流所归属的呼叫中心实例

Type.description_en: The flow type, as defined by ContactFlowType
Type.description_zh: 流程类型, 定义来自于ContactFlowType

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance to which the phone number belongs
InstanceId.description_zh: 电话号码所归属的呼叫中心实例ID

NumberCommodityStatus.description_en:
The commodity status of the number. Valid values:
0: Normal.
1: overdue payment.
2: instance deleted
NumberCommodityStatus.description_zh: 号码商品状态 0 正常  1 欠费 2 实例已删除

PhoneNumberDescription.description_en: The description of the phone number

PhoneNumberId.description_en: The phone number ID. This is a unique identifier automatically generated by the system
PhoneNumberId.description_zh: 电话号码ID，系统自动生成的唯一标示符

PrivacyNumber.description_en: The privacy number binding associated with the phone number
PrivacyNumber.description_zh: 电话号码所绑定的虚拟号码关系

Extra.description_en: The additional parameters, stored as a JSON string
Extra.description_zh: 其他参数，以Json字符串存入

PhoneNumber.description_en: The bound Cloud Call Center number

PoolId.description_en: The ID of the pool to which the privacy number belongs

PoolName.description_en: The name of the privacy number pool

RegionNameCity.description_en: The city where the privacy number is registered

SubId.description_en: The unique identifier of the binding relationship returned when the type is AXN. This field is empty if the type is AXB
SubId.description_zh: 类型为AXN，返回的绑定关系唯一标识，若类型为AXB，则此字段为空

TelX.description_en: The privacy number bound in AXN mode. This field is empty if the type is AXB
TelX.description_zh: 选择AXN模式绑定的虚拟号码，若类型为AXB，则此字段为空

Type.description_en: The type of the privacy number binding. Valid values: AXN and AXB
Type.description_zh: 选择绑定虚拟号码的类型，包括AXN和AXB

Province.description_en: The province of the phone number

RemainingTime.description_en: The remaining call time of the test number. Unit: minutes
RemainingTime.description_zh: 测试号码剩余的通话时间。单位为分钟

SkillGroup.description_en: The skill groups associated with the phone number
SkillGroup.description_zh: 电话号码所关联的技能组

TestOnly.description_en: Indicates whether the phone number is a test number

Trunks.description_en: The number of trunks for the phone number, which indicates how many concurrent calls are supported. The data is provided by the provider
Trunks.description_zh: 电话号码的中继数量，即可同时支持几路通话，数据来源于大于

Usage.description_en:
The usage of the phone number: inbound (Inbound), outbound (Outbound), or both inbound and outbound (Bidirection). These values are defined by the PhoneNumberType enumeration.

The result depends on:

The provider settings. For example, 400 numbers do not allow outbound calls.
The Cloud Call Center instance settings.

Phone numbers generally allow inbound calls. If inbound calls are not allowed, you can: 1) Configure the provider settings so that callers hear a prompt tone when dialing the number. 2) Disconnect the number from the contact flow IVR. However, this approach is not recommended
Usage.description_zh:
电话号码的用途，呼入（Inbound），呼出（Outbound），已经同时用于呼入和呼出（Bidirection）。上述值由枚举类型PhoneNumberType定义。

该值的结果取决于：

大于的设置，比如400号码不允许外呼
呼叫中心实例的设置

电话号码一般都允许内呼，如果不允许内呼，可以1）由大于做设置，用户拨打该号码时听到提示音 2）该号码不连接人和联系流IVR，但是ACC不建议这么做

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
